name: Imazu 17 -- parallel, no risk + crossing from port + crossing from starboard (3 targets)
own_ship_role: none (no give-way/stand-on situation) re: ts1 / stand-on to ts2 / give-way to ts3
description: Canonical Imazu problem 17 (Sawada/Zhai Appendix D reconstruction), reproduced with the exact own-ship/target start positions, headings, and speeds from the reference scenario in Data/Imazu Missions/imazu/imazu/17/17.ini -- kept geometrically identical to the published benchmark so results can be compared directly against other papers using the same Imazu case. ts1 shares own-ship's course and speed with no closing risk; ts2 crosses from port (abeam); ts3 crosses from starboard (broad).
pass_criteria: Own-ship recognises the same-course/same-speed target creates no closing risk and does not manoeuvre unnecessarily for it.
Own-ship holds course/speed as stand-on for the target(s) crossing from port, only acting under Rule 17(b) if the other vessel clearly fails to act.
Own-ship gives way early and substantially (normally to starboard) for the target(s) crossing from starboard, and avoids crossing ahead if circumstances allow.
Own-ship's manoeuvre for one target does not create a new close-quarters situation with another (Rule 8(d)).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
